description.zh: 井里有清澈的水，井沿反复出现同一个团字。
description.en: Clear water fills the well. The same glyph is repeated on its rim.

description.zh: 图示画着一只手从容器中拿出东西，旁边刻着一个团字。
description.en: A drawing shows a hand taking something out of a container. One glyph is carved beside it.

description.zh: 一串足迹沿通道向前延伸，路边的箭头旁刻着一个团字。
description.en: Footprints continue along the passage. A glyph is carved beside a forward-pointing arrow.

description.zh: 这个托盘里只有一袋补给，下方刻着一个数量团字。
description.en: This tray holds one supply bag. A quantity glyph is carved below it.

description.zh: 另一个托盘里并排放着两袋补给，下方刻着不同的数量团字。
description.en: The other tray holds two supply bags side by side. A different quantity glyph is carved below it.

description.zh: 木牌画着手从水井接水的动作，旁边并排刻着两个字。
description.en: The board depicts a hand taking water from a well. Two glyphs are carved beside the drawing.

description.zh: 纤维间积着一小汪水，旁边的石头上刻着与井沿相同的字。
description.en: Water gathers between the fibres. A nearby stone bears the same glyph as the well rim.

description.zh: 残骸背板上刻着一行有序团字，周围散着旧补给容器。
description.en: An ordered line of glyphs is carved into the wreck backplate beside old supply containers.
